race.description: Byron Bay Police Social Club Mdn Plate
race.comment: STAY SPENDING (12) has the most attractive upside second-up for the Michael Freedman yard after debuting at Newcastle over 1300m. She was only fair there and the 1600m is new, but this looks a more suitable maiden and Andrew Mallyon taking the ride at Ballina adds confidence. MR PARAGON (6) is the clear danger after being beaten only a length and a half at the Gold Coast despite covering ground, with third-up fitness giving him a strong platform. Respect from the draw. PUNGWE RIVER (2) comes back from provincial grade and had a genuine excuse after striking trouble at the Gold Coast when seventh. Assess on the Eagle Farm placing three back. TENDUE'S SPIRIT (10) stretches out to this trip for the first time this campaign has been around the mark at her last couple of starts. Placed at this distance previously and meets PUNGWE RIVER again after finishing ahead of him at Murwillumbah.
